name: optim-jev
description: Jev based token-usage optimization tools for Claude Code workflows.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for the Jev API. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

python.title: Python executable
python.description: Python 3.10+ used to run the tools, e.g. python, python3 or a full path. Empty means python.

jev_dashboard_mode.title: Dashboard
jev_dashboard_mode.description: on: show live compacter, router and skill-picker status above the prompt. off: use the compact status line instead.

jev_compacter_mode.title: Compaction: Jev
jev_compacter_mode.description: on: /compact and auto-compaction prune stale tool calls with Jev, keeping everything else verbatim. off: Claude Code's built-in summary.

jev_compacter_soft_percent.title: Compaction: soft threshold (%)
jev_compacter_soft_percent.description: Context fill at which Jev pruning is tried after a turn. Empty means 60.

jev_compacter_hard_percent.title: Compaction: hard threshold (%)
jev_compacter_hard_percent.description: Context fill at which compaction must shrink, falling back to the built-in summary. Empty means 85.

jev_compacter_target_percent.title: Compaction: target (%)
jev_compacter_target_percent.description: A pruning that lands at or below this fill is always applied. Empty means 40.

jev_compacter_min_freed_tokens.title: Compaction: minimum tokens freed
jev_compacter_min_freed_tokens.description: Above the target, a pruning is applied only if it frees at least this many tokens. Empty means 8000.

jev_compacter_keep_threshold.title: Compaction: keep threshold
jev_compacter_keep_threshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for a tool call or its output to stay. Empty means 0.5.

jev_compacter_preserve_recent_messages.title: Compaction: recent messages kept
jev_compacter_preserve_recent_messages.description: Newest messages never touched. Empty means 6.

jev_skills_mode.title: Skills: Jev picker
jev_skills_mode.description: on: the built-in list of every skill is left out; Jev shortlists the skills each prompt needs. /jev-skills on|off changes it per session.

jev_skills_scope.title: Skills: scope
jev_skills_scope.description: project: .claude/skills in this project. global: also ~/.claude/skills and installed plugins' skills, whose folders Claude may then read without asking.

jev_skills_max_picks.title: Skills: shortlist size
jev_skills_max_picks.description: Most skills shortlisted for one prompt. Empty means 3.

jev_skills_min_percent.title: Skills: shortlist bar (%)
jev_skills_min_percent.description: Jev's share a skill needs to be shortlisted (it must also beat 'none'). Empty means 30.

jev_router_mode.title: Router: default mode
jev_router_mode.description: on: the main model changes files only through subagents, and Jev picks each subagent's model. /jev-route on|off changes it per session.

jev_router_cap.title: Router: cap at the session model
jev_router_cap.description: on: Jev never picks a subagent model above the session's (rules and escalation still can).

jev_router_escalate_after.title: Router: errors before escalating
jev_router_escalate_after.description: Failed edits in one subagent after which the next subagent for its files starts a model up. Empty means 3.

jev_router_init_model.title: Router: rules writer model
jev_router_init_model.description: Model that drafts rules.json during /jev-route init. Empty means sonnet.
